## Activation Contract

Use for release-note drafting; do not use for code changes.

## Hard Rules

Confirm facts from the supplied change list.

## Decision Gates

| Situation | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Missing facts | Ask for the release scope. |

## Execution Steps

1. Group verified changes by user outcome.
2. Draft concise notes.

## Output Contract

Return the release note and unresolved facts.
